brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base at 0,0,0 with top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top), bottom cover (cover:0,0,0;full;bottom) and 6 side caps (cap:0,0,0;*;30/90/150/210/270/330) fully enclosing the cell; check_build meshClash=clear
Port louvre installed in wall slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0, stem hex-port-louvre) – provides rain-protected ventilation per catalog description

finish.summary: Built minimal single-cell sealed enclosure: full hex base capped on all 6 sides with solid top and bottom covers, plus one louvred port vent in slot 0 to allow the board to breathe. check_build passes with meshClash clear.
